question: The diagrams below show the development of the horse over a period of 40 million years. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
question_transcription: Transcribed from original prompt cover; original page remains authoritative.
essay: The diagrams give information about horse evolution from 40 million years ago to today. Overall, over the past 40 million years, the horse has evolved from a small quadruped into a much larger one, with the most noticeable changes being those to the foot structure, which gradually evolved into a hoof. The first ancestor shown is called the Eohippus, which existed 40 million years ago. It was a small four-legged animal, bearing little resemblance to the modern horse and featuring four separate digits on each foot After 10 million years, it had been superseded by Mesohippus, which was slightly larger and had a longer neck.
